questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests the ability to design end-to-end provenance systems with multi-region operational requirements, tenant isolation, and production-grade constraints.

## Key Concepts
- CNF provenance using Cosign and SPDX SBOMs
- Per-tenant KMS key management and rotation
- Attestation storage in SigStore with Rekor transparency
- Admission control via ImagePolicyWebhook and Kyverno
- Revocation through CRLs and transparency logs
- Offline edge verification with bundled certificates
- Minimal scheduling impact through async verification

## Code Example
```yaml
# Example Kyverno policy for CNF provenance enforcement
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: cnf-provenance-policy
spec:
  validationFailureAction: enforce
  rules:
  - name: verify-image-signature
    match:
      any:
      - resources:
          kinds:
          - Pod
    verifyImages:
    - imageReferences:
      - "*"
      required: true
      attestors:
      - entries:
        - keys:
            kms: "aws-kms://key-id"
      attestations:
      - predicateType: "spdx"
        conditions:
        - all:
          - key: "{{ attestor.metadata.name }}"
            operator: Equals
            value: "tenant-{{ request.namespace }}"
```

## Why This Is Asked
Tests resilience isolation, tenant RBAC, and end-to-end chaos execution in CNF gateways. Demands practical familiarity with LitmusChaos, CRDs, and debugging cross-tenant faults.

## Key Concepts
- Namespace isolation and RBAC for chaos tooling
- ChaosExperiment and ChaosEngine CRDs
- Label-based target selection and end-to-end validation

## Code Example
```yaml
# RBAC: Tenant isolation for chaos tooling
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: tenant-chaos-admin
  namespace: tenant-ns
rules:
- apiGroups: ["litmuschaos.io"]
  resources: ["chaosexperiments","chaosexperiments/status","chaosengines","chaosengines/status"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch","create","delete","patch","update"]
```
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: tenant-chaos-admin-binding
  namespace: tenant-ns
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: chaos-sa
  namespace: tenant-ns
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: tenant-chaos-admin
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
```yaml
apiVersion: litmuschaos.io/v1alpha1
kind: ChaosExperiment
metadata:
  name: cpu-stress
  namespace: tenant-ns
spec:
  definition:
    image: litmuschaos/cpu-chaos:latest
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    args:
      - "-cpu-cores=1"
      - "-duration=30s"
```
```yaml
apiVersion: litmuschaos.io/v1alpha1
kind: ChaosEngine
metadata:
  name: cpu-stress-engine
  namespace: tenant-ns
spec:
  chaosServiceAccount: chaos-sa
  experiments:
  - name: cpu-stress
```
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gw
  namespace: tenant-ns
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: cnf-gw
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: cnf-gw

      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: your-org/cnf-gw:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: litmuschaos.io/v1alpha1
kind: ChaosEngine
metadata:
  name: test-engine
  namespace: tenant-ns
spec:
  chaosServiceAccount: chaos-sa
  experiments:
  - name: cpu-stress
```
